parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by radioactive decay.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Use Fig. 13.1 to determine the activity, in Bq, of the sample of technetium-101 at time $t = 14.0$ minutes. Show your working.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Without calculating the half-life of technetium-101, use your answer in (i) to determine the decay constant $\lambda$ of technetium-101.
